title: Deliver Agent Terminal, transactions, analytics, trust, and agency operations
outcome: Licensed agents and authorized agency teams can manage previous/current/future customers, leads, tasks, viewings, offers, deals, contracts, renewals, listing analytics, verified reviews, and subscription entitlements with auditable authority.
rationale: Program-level child spanning roadmap P07-P10, P17, and P19. It must be recursively refined before implementation.
scope_in: P07 Agent Terminal CRM and tasks
P10 analytics event model and dashboards
P17 reviews, reputation, and trust graph
acceptance: Agent/transaction capabilities are decomposed into bounded Grains with explicit lifecycle states, authorization, audit, idempotency, unknown-outcome handling, analytics semantics, and review eligibility.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; external transactions remain gated by refined adapter Grains.
